Summary: [NFR][TS-02][TC-01] Verify that the system can process the equivalent of one production business day of TDN trades while maintaining acceptable performance and resource utilization
Description:
Test Suite: TS-02
Test Case: TC-01
Category: Performance

Objective
Verify that the system can process the equivalent of one production business day of TDN trades while maintaining acceptable performance and resource utilization

Steps / Expected Results
1. Action: Inject a workload equivalent to one production day for TDN accounts
   Expected: All events are processed successfully
2. Action: Measure transactions per second (TPS)
   Expected: TPS meets or exceeds the target throughput
3. Action: Monitor JVM memory consumption
   Expected: Memory usage remains stable with no excessive garbage collection activity
4. Action: Monitor Kafka topic growth and retention
   Expected: Topic size remains within expected limits
5. Action: Analyze database storage consumption (tables and indexes)
   Expected: Database growth remains within expected capacity limits

Summary: [NFR][TS-04][TC-02] Verify that Zephyr can recover from a Kafka outage and correctly process buffered events once Kafka becomes available again
Description:
Test Suite: TS-04
Test Case: TC-02
Category: Resiliency

Objective
Verify that Zephyr can recover from a Kafka outage and correctly process buffered events once Kafka becomes available again

Steps / Expected Results
1. Action: Start Zephyr while Kafka is unavailable
   Expected: Zephyr starts successfully and stores incoming events in the database
2. Action: Inject trade events into the system
   Expected: All trade related events are persisted without loss
3. Action: Start the Kafka broker
   Expected: All pending events are published to Kafka and processing resumes normally
